nodes.name: Context Assembly.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node defining the Context Assembly capability: assembles typed context packs for Claude Code sessions by retrieving, filtering, and grounding dev_graph nodes before any coding task.
nodes.languageNotes: Ontology-governed Markdown node following the dev_graph universal schema with 14 structured sections including Definition, Purpose, Architecture Role, Inputs, Outputs, Constraints, and Relationships.

nodes.name: Decision Making.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node defining the Decision Making capability: encodes the policy and logic by which the trading system chooses whether to enter, hold, or exit positions based on signals, regime, and guardrails.
nodes.languageNotes: Ontology-governed Markdown node with 14 structured sections covering both the trading decision policy and its architecture role within the el_nino system hierarchy.

nodes.name: Exposure Tracking.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node defining Exposure Tracking: monitors aggregate market exposure (gross, net, per-symbol) across all open paper-trade positions to enforce risk limits.
nodes.languageNotes: Compact capability node (63 lines) with 12 sections; slightly shorter than peers, reflecting a focused single-responsibility capability without open-question deferred contracts.

nodes.name: Feature Engineering.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node defining Feature Engineering: transforms raw market data into normalized feature vectors consumed by signal generators and regime classifiers.
nodes.languageNotes: One of the more connected capability nodes with 15 sections including Validated By and Constrained By subsections, reflecting ML-pipeline governance requirements.

nodes.name: Gold Decision Generation.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node defining Gold Decision Generation: produces the historically optimal (gold-label) trading decisions used as ground-truth for benchmarking and model validation, including an Open Questions section for unresolved deferred contracts.
nodes.languageNotes: The most section-rich capability node in this batch (21 sections, 109 lines) including a Supersedes subsection, reflecting its role as an evolved replacement for an older generation approach.

nodes.name: Guardrail Enforcement.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node defining Guardrail Enforcement: applies hard pre-trade and post-trade constraints (position size, exposure, drawdown) to prevent dangerous trading behavior.
nodes.languageNotes: Capability node with an expanded Contains subsection (lines 62-70) listing multiple guard types, reflecting the composite nature of this safety-critical capability.

nodes.name: Market Regime Classification.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node defining Market Regime Classification: labels the current market environment (trending, ranging, volatile, etc.) to gate signal generation and adjust position sizing.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes a dedicated 'Related Schemas / Tests / Decisions' section (line 58) in addition to the standard Relationships block, giving extra traceability to validation artifacts.

nodes.name: Market Scanning.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node defining Market Scanning: continuously screens the universe of tradable symbols against liquidity, volatility, and regime filters to produce a ranked candidate list for downstream signal generation.

nodes.name: Order Management.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node defining Order Management: the execution layer that translates approved trade decisions into paper-order lifecycle events (fill, partial-fill, cancel, expire) per ADR-011 re-grounding.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest capability node in this batch (139 lines, 18 sections) with a dedicated 'Scope (Execution Layer Re-grounding, ADR-011)' section, reflecting a major architectural re-alignment.

nodes.name: Paper-Trade Admission.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node defining Paper-Trade Admission: the gateway capability that validates incoming trade signals against all guardrails and exposure limits before committing them as live paper positions.
nodes.languageNotes: One of the more detailed capability nodes (116 lines, 19 sections) with an Open Questions section, reflecting active architectural uncertainty around admission sequencing.

nodes.name: Performance Scoring.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node defining Performance Scoring: computes per-strategy and per-agent performance metrics (Sharpe, win rate, drawdown) used for promotion decisions and benchmarking.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes a dedicated 'Key Metrics' section (line 51) enumerating the quantitative measures tracked, supplementing the standard capability template.

nodes.name: Position Tracking.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node defining Position Tracking: maintains the live ledger of open and closed paper-trade positions, reconciling fills with order events to produce accurate P&L state.
nodes.languageNotes: Rich relationship section (17 subsections) with both Consumes/Produces and Implemented By/Validated By subsections, reflecting tight coupling to the execution and persistence layers.

nodes.name: Promotion Validation.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node defining Promotion Validation: evaluates whether a paper-trading strategy has met the Syndicate Squad promotion criteria to advance to a higher-confidence trading tier.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains a domain-specific 'Promotion Criteria (Syndicate Squad)' section (line 51), making this the primary reference for squad promotion thresholds within the ontology.

nodes.name: Signal Generation.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node defining Signal Generation: produces directional trade signals (long/short/hold) from feature vectors and regime labels, acting as the core alpha-generation capability.

nodes.name: Snapshot Assembly.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node defining Snapshot Assembly: aggregates multi-source market data into a consistent, timestamped snapshot packet consumed by feature engineering and regime classification.

nodes.name: State Persistence.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node defining State Persistence: durably stores all trading engine state (positions, orders, scores) to a backing store, enabling crash recovery and audit trail.

nodes.name: Stop-Loss Management.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node defining Stop-Loss Management: monitors open positions against configurable stop-loss thresholds and emits close signals when breach conditions are met.

nodes.name: Team Orchestration.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node defining Team Orchestration: coordinates the multi-agent squad lifecycle — spawning, scheduling, retiring, and promoting agent teams within the trading engine.

nodes.name: Trade Logging.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node defining Trade Logging: records every trade event (entry, exit, partial fill, cancel) with full audit context to the append-only trade log.

nodes.name: Treasury Management.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node defining Treasury Management: governs capital allocation across squads and strategies, enforcing policy gates on drawdown, allocation limits, and rebalancing triggers.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains dedicated 'Treasury Model' and 'Policy Gates' sections (lines 52-68), making this the authoritative reference for the capital allocation policy within the ontology.
